$comment: Capture metadata for the README screenshots. `showsVersion` is the release whose UI the image depicts; bump it only after re-capturing (or re-verifying against the current build). `sources` are the code files the image actually depicts and `verifiedThrough` is the commit at which the image was last confirmed to match them — `npm run check` diffs those files from that commit to HEAD and warns with the changed list, so an outdated capture cannot hide. A `showsVersion` behind package.json fails the check unless the path is listed in acknowledgedStale with a reason. See docs/screenshots.md.
